title: Orbs seen during sky observing at Bledsoe home

tellings.quote: right above the trees about 3 or 400 m away this thing flashed into existence it was a massive orb very bright

plain: Bob McGwier, a former CIA contractor, says that while watching the sky at the North Carolina home of Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs, "this thing flashed into existence": a massive, very bright orb just above the trees, 300 or 400 meters away. McGwier tells Michels he saw it himself, alongside Bledsoe, his son Ryan Bledsoe and the writer Richard Dolan.
